title.zh: V4.1-Flash-1017 更新，站内搜索 API 开放
title.en: V4.1-Flash-1017 update and in-house search API

summary.zh: 针对 DeepSeek Harness 做专项优化，引入基于自反馈强化学习的编程能力；同日开放自研搜索 Search 与网页读取 Fetch 两个 API，按成功请求计费。
summary.en: A targeted update for DeepSeek Harness with self-feedback RL for coding. The in-house Search and Fetch APIs opened the same day, billed per successful request.

title.zh: V4.1 Flash：非对称架构，原生多模态
title.en: V4.1 Flash: asymmetric architecture with native vision

summary.zh: 552B 参数 MoE，全新 Causal Encoder–Decoder 结构，输入激活 8B、输出激活 16B；KV Cache 对 HBM 需求降至前代 1/4、SSD 1/8，API 同步降价，V4 Pro 逐步下线。
summary.en: A 552B MoE with a new Causal Encoder-Decoder design, 8B active on input and 16B on output. KV cache needs 1/4 the HBM and 1/8 the SSD storage; API prices dropped and V4 Pro was phased out.

title.zh: V4 预览版：迈入百万上下文，同步开源

summary.zh: 全新 V4 系列预览版上线并同步开源，带来百万字级超长上下文，Flash 与 Pro 两个尺寸同时进入模型目录。
summary.en: The V4 preview shipped with million-token context and open weights, adding Flash and Pro variants to the model catalog.

title.zh: V3.2 正式版：思考融入工具使用
title.en: V3.2: reasoning integrated into tool use

summary.zh: V3.2 与 V3.2-Speciale 发布，强化 Agent 能力，成为首个将思考融入工具使用的模型，并在 IMO、CMO、ICPC、IOI 取得金牌级成绩；网页端、App 与 API 全面上线。
summary.en: V3.2 and V3.2-Speciale strengthened agent capabilities as the first model to integrate reasoning into tool use, with gold-medal results in IMO, CMO, ICPC and IOI.

title.zh: V3.2-Exp：稀疏注意力，API 降价过半
title.en: V3.2-Exp: sparse attention and lower API prices

summary.zh: 引入 DeepSeek Sparse Attention（DSA）稀疏注意力机制，提升长上下文训练与推理效率，API 价格下调 50% 以上。
summary.en: Introduced DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) for more efficient long-context training and inference, cutting API prices by more than 50%.

summary.zh: V3.1 更新至 Terminus 版本，缓解中英文混杂问题，优化 Code Agent 与 Search Agent 表现。
summary.en: The Terminus update for V3.1 reduced mixed-language artifacts and improved Code Agent and Search Agent behaviour.

title.zh: V3.1：混合思考与更长上下文
title.en: V3.1: hybrid thinking and longer context

summary.zh: V3.1 进入模型目录，引入思考与非思考模式的切换，并扩展上下文长度，成为后续 Agent 系列的基础版本。
summary.en: V3.1 added switchable thinking and non-thinking modes with a longer context window, becoming the base for later agent-oriented releases.

summary.zh: V3 的一次重要迭代，提升推理与代码能力，保持开源权重分发。
summary.en: A notable V3 iteration improving reasoning and coding while keeping open-weight distribution.

summary.zh: DeepSeek-R1 发布并开源权重与训练方法，让强化学习驱动的推理能力可被复现，成为当年最受关注的模型事件之一。
summary.en: DeepSeek-R1 shipped with open weights and published methodology, making RL-driven reasoning reproducible and becoming one of the year's most discussed releases.

summary.zh: DeepSeek-V3 发布，6710 亿总参数、每 token 激活 370 亿参数，以较低的训练成本达到前沿水平，并采用 MIT 许可证开源。
summary.en: DeepSeek-V3 arrived with 671B total and 37B active parameters per token, reaching frontier-level quality at low training cost under an MIT license.

summary.zh: V2 引入多头潜在注意力（MLA）与 DeepSeekMoE 稀疏结构，大幅降低推理显存与成本，奠定后续系列的架构基础。
summary.en: V2 introduced Multi-head Latent Attention and the DeepSeekMoE sparse design, cutting inference memory and cost and setting the architecture for later generations.

title.en: DeepSeek Coder: the first open models

summary.zh: 从代码模型起步，同年 11 月发布 DeepSeek LLM，开启以开源权重与技术报告为主的发布节奏。
summary.en: Starting with a code model, followed by DeepSeek LLM later that month, establishing a release cadence built on open weights and technical reports.
